notes: New: customizable Dashboard. Every card can now be dragged into any order, removed, and added back (via a new 'Add a card' section), independently for each admin - click 'Customize' at the top of the Dashboard. Everyone still only ever sees cards for sections they actually have access to, same as before. The 'Sign out' button that used to sit on the Dashboard's welcome card is removed (it's already in the account menu, top-right). Requires 'Update database' after installing this update (adds one column).
